name: Zen Tiny Homes
description:
Zen Tiny Homes is not a conventional home builder that simply scales down a standard floor plan. They are a small-space living specialist that designs every square foot around how a client actually lives—turning compact footprints into intentional, comfortable, high-functioning homes.

Zen Tiny Homes is a San Diego–based custom tiny-home builder helping people create beautifully designed, practical homes that make more out of less space. Unlike traditional home builders, Zen begins with the realities of compact living: how the homeowner will cook, sleep, work, store belongings, entertain, access the home, and use the surrounding property. The result is a tiny home designed around daily life—not a reduced version of a conventional house.

From the earliest property assessment through custom design and construction, Zen Tiny Homes works directly with each client to develop a home that reflects their lifestyle, land, priorities, and budget. Every project is an opportunity to rethink space: creating efficient layouts, meaningful storage, flexible living areas, inviting interiors, and a sense of openness that allows a smaller home to feel personal, usable, and complete.

What truly sets Zen Tiny Homes apart is its experience at the intersection of design, construction, and tiny-home feasibility. The company has spent more than a decade building tiny homes and working with local agencies on pathways for legal tiny-home living across San Diego County, Los Angeles, Riverside, and surrounding Southern California communities. That experience helps clients move beyond the dream of a small home and toward a realistic plan for assessing their property, designing the right build, and navigating the unique considerations that come with tiny-home placement.

Zen Tiny Homes is an American-owned small business committed to making high-quality, custom tiny living more accessible without sacrificing craftsmanship. Whether the goal is a primary residence, backyard ADU-style living solution, guest space, multigenerational housing option, rental unit, or a thoughtfully designed retreat, Zen creates homes that prove square footage is not the same as livability. Their process is deliberately simple—property assessment, design, and build—but the outcome is highly personal: a home that uses space intelligently and supports the life happening inside it.

Google Business Profile

Zen Tiny Homes is a San Diego custom tiny-home builder specializing in beautifully designed, high-functioning small spaces. We work one-on-one with clients to assess their property, create a personalized design, and build a tiny home around the way they truly live. With over a decade of experience and deep knowledge of Southern California tiny-home requirements, we help make compact living practical, legal-minded, comfortable, and uniquely personal.

Key differentiators from other construction companies:

Small-space-first design: The build starts with space efficiency and livability, rather than shrinking a traditional-home layout.

Truly custom homes: Zen works one-on-one with clients on fully customized tiny-home designs.

End-to-end simplicity: Their process covers property assessment, design, and construction.

Local feasibility knowledge: Zen has worked with city and county stakeholders and studied zoning and planning considerations affecting tiny-home living in Southern California.

Livability over square footage: The positioning should emphasize purposeful, personalized homes—not merely “small houses.”

More than a structure: The home can serve as a primary residence, guest suite, rental opportunity, multigenerational solution, or private retreat, depending on local requirements and the property.

We don’t just build smaller homes—we design smarter ways to live.
